meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 把 oh-my-opencode 发布到 npm:按给定版本类型触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,跟进到跑完,核对 npm 包与 GitHub Release,补写发布说明,尝试发 Discord 公告;不做代码复查或修复。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等发布相关词,并指定 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号时触发;没给版本类型会先询问。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 新版本。
say.note: 按 bug 修复版本触发发布工作流。

say.text: 把最新改动发布成 minor 版本。
say.note: 按新增功能的兼容版本发布。
显式版本号无需再选择升级类型。

howto.what_en: It triggers the oh-my-opencode GitHub Actions publish workflow and follows it to the end: checks npm versions and the GitHub release, writes release notes, attempts a Discord post — no code review or fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “publish”, “release”, “deploy”, etc., and supplies a release type: patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver such as 5.0.0-beta.9. If none is given, Claude asks first.

say_en.note: Runs the release flow for a bug-fix bump.

say_en.text: Release the latest changes as a minor version.

say_en.note: Explicit semver, no bump type needed.
